# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c28 P2](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v3 c5 P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c13 P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as neat, sensible, plain, and plump, with pink cheeks and a fat paw.

_Sources: [v2 c6 P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Personality

Jane is placid, steady, composed, and extremely practical, lacking soaring ambitions or a vivid imagination. She is conscientious, honest, and strictly lived up to her religious professions. Although she can be cold or stiff when her family's pride is offended, she is generally amiable, kind-hearted, and careful never to hurt anyone's feelings.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P0](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0000), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 c13 P38](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0038), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 c8 P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025), [v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010)_

## Goals

- To earn her salary, please the school trustees, and get her name on the School Inspector's roll of honor  <sub>[v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002)</sub>

## History

Jane grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry, joining their story club where she contributed very sensible stories. She studied for the Entrance examinations and attended Queen's Academy, earning honors in the domestic science course and getting her teacher's license. She began her teaching career at Newbridge, earning a place on the Inspector's Roll of Honor before taking over the Avonlea school. Later, she taught out West on the prairies. While visiting Anne during a holiday, she proposed to Anne on behalf of her shy brother Billy, though Anne declined. Jane eventually met and married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy greyish Englishman who made millions in mines, moving with him to Winnipeg and taking a honeymoon trip to Europe.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c35 P13](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0013), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c26 P35](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0035), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c39 P26](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0026), [v3 c39 P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035)_
